primaryChecks.text: Asher didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;
primaryChecks.nextContext: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, for they didn’t drive them out.

primaryChecks.text: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and served the Baals, the Ashtaroth, the gods of Syria, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines. They abandoned the LORD, and didn’t serve him.
primaryChecks.previousContext: All the men of Shechem assembled themselves together with all the house of Millo, and went and made Abimelech king by the oak of the pillar that was in Shechem.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the children of Ammon.

primaryChecks.text: There was no deliverer, because it was far from Sidon, and they had no dealings with anyone else; and it was in the valley that lies by Beth Rehob. They built the city and lived in it.
primaryChecks.nextContext: They called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel; however the name of the city used to be Laish.
